item.title: An AI agent published a hit piece on me
Launch HN: Omnara (YC S25) – Run Claude Code and Codex from anywhere
item.description:
📝 As the Claude Agent SDK matured, it gave us enough control to rewrite Omnara from scratch and run the agent loop directly. Omnara keeps that property by running a small headless daemon on the user’s machine (or a remote VM) that hosts the agent loop. In the current version, Omnara can continue an agent session in a hosted remote sandbox when your local machine goes offline.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46991591
